# Kirtan Chandak

> Software developer at Kuration AI, building AI agents, MCP servers, and developer tooling. Google Summer of Code contributor and LFX intern at Vitess (Linux Foundation).

## About

Kirtan Chandak is a software developer based in Pune, India. He currently works at Kuration AI as a Founding Engineer, building AI agents and developer tools. He was a Google Summer of Code contributor with OpenFoodFacts and a Linux Foundation (LFX) mentee with Vitess.

He is also a Microsoft Student Ambassador and has won hackathons including ETH Global Online and Smart India Hackathon.

## Experience

- [Kuration AI](https://kurationai.com): Software Developer (Nov 2024 – Present)
- [Google Summer of Code](https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com): Software Developer (May 2025 – Sep 2025)
- [Linux Foundation (Vitess)](https://vitess.io): LFX Intern (Jun 2024 – Aug 2024)

## Projects

- [groundtruth](https://github.com/kirtanchandak/groundtruth): An autonomous AI data steward that continuously audits enterprise databases.
- [baton](https://github.com/flex3-org/baton): Keeps context alive across async agent handoffs. Built for Slack.

## Side Projects

- [llmbuys](https://github.com/kirtanchandak/llmbuys): An AI agent skill that audits your website by testing what AI says about your product to customers.
- [rant](https://github.com/kirtanchandak/rant): A brain dump and private journal with pgvector search so old notes come back when you need them.
- [weekend.warrior](https://github.com/kirtanchandak/weekend.warrior): A retro-themed GitHub analyzer that tracks your weekend commits with a CRT aesthetic.

## Technologies

Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Docker, AWS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Prisma, FastAPI, Azure, Supabase, Node.js, Express.js, SQL, Clerk, GitHub Actions
